title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Streams 'Yoroshiku★Girl' Segment Early on Netflix for Limited Time
content: The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) announced on Monday that the film's "Yoroshiku★Girl" segment will stream early for a limited time on Netflix in Japan from October 23-November 5, before the film opens on November 6.
author: ANN

title: Dr. Stone Creator’s New Shonen Jump Series Ends Before Getting a Chance
content: Dr. Stone remains one of the most iconic and unique Shonen Jump series even several years after the finale. The award-winning manga is written by Riichiro Inagaki and illustrated by Boichi, and began serialization in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2017.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach Officially Ends the Anime’s Final Fight After 22 Years With Epic Finale
content: It’s taken 22 years of waiting until this point, but the newest episode of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has officially brought the anime’s final fight to an end with a truly epic finish.
author: ComicBook

title: Lezhin Ent. to Launch AI Character Chat Service Teaz in Korea
content: Lezhin Entertainment will launch Teaz, an AI character chat service based on its webtoon intellectual properties (IPs), on October 19 in Korea. Announced on October 12, Teaz will allow users to interact directly with characters from original series published on Lezhin Comics and Bomtoon .
author: ANN

title: Sony Might Have Found Its Next Big Live-Action Anime Movie
content: It seems like Sony Pictures might have found their next big live-action anime and manga movie adaptation according to a new report, and it’s literally going to have some of the biggest characters yet.
author: ComicBook

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals Final Battle Visual Ahead of Last Anime Episode
content: BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War has revealed a new “THE STORIES VISUAL – Final Battle” visual following the premiere of Episode 49, “THE BLADE.” The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality .
author: Anime Corner

title: Black Clover Season 2 Preview Reveals First Look at a Major Flashback
content: Black Clover Season 2 is now working its way through the Fall 2026 anime season, and the first look preview images for Episode 4 of the series are teasing Nacht and Yami’s major flashback.
author: ComicBook

title: EST N8 Picks Up Korean-Animated Film Pilgrims for Worldwide Sales
content: EST N8, an American entertainment company, announced on October 8 it has acquired worldwide sales rights to Pilgrims , a Korean science-fiction animated feature that screened at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival and won a technical award at the 2025 Bucheon International Animation Festival (BIAF).
author: ANN
